text: Every invoice now follows the same four real steps -- entry with the right warehouse cost center, Subledger Accounting, GL posting, and a reconciliation check before close.
Arjun Mehta's team enters the correct cost center at the distribution line every time; the corrected rule simply carries that forward into the journal honestly.
Simone Alvarez can now pull a department-level view by cost center across Midwest, Southeast, West, and Corporate -- and actually trust what it shows her.
Elena Marchetti's team still reads Oracle's standard financial reports, not a custom BI layer -- a real, named idea for a later phase, not a hidden gap.
Next: writing the real implementation documentation and handoff, with the cost center incident recorded as a lesson for whoever touches this configuration next.
